primary_analysis: Confirmatory paired analysis using per-task final verifier-pass labels (baseline vs guarded) from execution/scoring/*.json. Test: paired McNemar (two-sided, alpha=0.05). Report: contingency counts (both-pass, baseline-only, guarded-only, neither), exact McNemar p-value, risk difference (guarded − baseline) with 95% Wilson confidence interval. Preserve pairing by using task_id alignment in execution/raw_results.jsonl and execution/task_manifest.jsonl. Apply failed-call treatment as specified in failed_call_treatment.
secondary_analyses: Paired Wilcoxon signed-rank test on model_call_count (report median, IQR per pipeline and p-value) using result model_call_count fields in execution/raw_results.jsonl.
Failure-mode taxonomy: counts and percentages of verifier-assertion categories and top-3 assertion types causing failures (use execution/scoring/*.json assertions).
Time-to-pass descriptive statistics (wall_time_seconds distribution per pipeline): median, IQR, min/max; report distribution plots.
Discordant-pair analysis: list and sample examples (hashed artifact paths) of tasks where pipelines disagree, with verifier assertions pre/post-repair for guarded pipeline.
sensitivity_analyses: Exclude tasks flagged with 'residual_uncertainty' or 'potential_contamination' in per-task records and repeat primary McNemar analysis (report effect-size difference vs primary).

Alternate failed-call handling sensitivity: rerun primary analysis treating any technical/failed model call pairs per task as baseline-fail/guarded-fail=0 according to contract id 'complete_pair_primary_with_failure_as_zero_sensitivity' and report difference from primary.
Multiplicity-context sensitivity: report Benjamini–Hochberg FDR-adjusted q-values across secondary hypothesis tests (labelled exploratory).
uncertainty_quantification: Exact McNemar p-value for primary inferential test; 95% Wilson CIs for per-pipeline pass proportions and for risk difference; paired Wilcoxon p-values for model-call counts; report median/IQR for nonparametric summaries. For exploratory summaries report raw p-values and BH-adjusted q-values.
multiplicity_implementation: Primary estimand is single prespecified confirmatory test (paired McNemar). All other tests are exploratory: report raw p-values and 95% CIs; when summarizing multiple exploratory tests present Benjamini–Hochberg FDR-adjusted q-values for context.
contamination_analysis: Use flags embedded in per-task result records ('residual_uncertainty', 'potential_contamination') from execution/raw_results.jsonl and execution/scoring/*.json. Produce counts of flagged items. Run cross-verifier audit on a 10% sample of passing configs using verifier outputs in execution/scoring to detect cross-verifier disagreement; mark disagreements as 'residual_uncertainty'. Detect verbatim matches to canonical held‑out configs (repository artifact referenced in preregistration) and mark as 'potential_contamination'. Primary analysis uses original verifier-pass labels; sensitivity analysis excludes flagged items and reports effect-size shifts. All prompt/response artifacts and hashes (execution/artifact_hashes paths) used for detection and logged.

Table 4: Contamination and audit summary: counts of 'residual_uncertainty' and 'potential_contamination' flags, cross-verifier disagreement counts, and effect on primary estimand when excluded. Source: execution/raw_results.jsonl and audit outputs.
